messages:
maya-ux: heads-up  tiny design proposal for the playground: inline "teasers" for function-call params in the run list so you can scan tool-calls without opening details. idea: show up to 2 params inline, then a keyboard-focusable '…' button to reveal the rest.

eli-devex: i like that. is the teaser content truncated token-wise or char-wise? we should avoid cutting mid-JSON token. :thinking_face:

sam-frontend: implementationally easier to truncate by characters but expose truncated token boundary in tooltip. also need to ensure the 'more' button has a clear aria-label like `Reveal parameters for run <id>`.

rachit-ml: for schema-tooling runs, show the function signature in bold (e.g., update_user(id, attrs)) and then param teasers. when a param is collapsed, surface a tiny warning if the value was truncated by model.

maya-ux: accessibility notes: 1) The teaser must be reachable by keyboard without expanding the whole run. 2) Screen readers should announce "params truncated" when that is the case. 3) prefer `aria-controls` + `aria-expanded`.

zoe-qa: QA checklist proposal:
- Tab to teaser button focuses it
- Enter/Space toggles reveal flyout
- SR reads: "Run 12345, collapsed parameters, press enter to expand"
- Focus returns to teaser after closing
I can run a test matrix on desktop + VoiceOver + NVDA.

eli-devex: copy nit: instead of 'more' or '…' use 'Show params' (visually we can keep ellipsis but aria-label should be 'Show params for run <id>').

sam-frontend: coding note: keep flyout as a portal to body to avoid overflow issues. use role="dialog" and trap focus. minimal animation is fine; avoid moving layout on reveal.

rachit-ml: UX edge-case: if a param is an array of objects, teaser should show only counts like `items: [3 objects]` rather than a giant inline. Also show schema compliance icon if the output mismatches expected type.

maya-ux: small visual idea: add a micro 'schema' badge next to function name when run included a validated schema. clicking badge opens a small diagnostics popover.

eli-devex: analytics: emit `ui.playground.param_teaser.expanded` and include run id, method, and whether schema_warning_present=true/false.

ops-bot: staging deploy: playground/param-teaser @staging -> success :white_check_mark: (build 2026-03-23.7)

sam-frontend: question: should Dense/Compact modes hide teasers entirely to save space? i'd say teasers show only in Comfortable and Expanded modes.

maya-ux: agree — teasers visible in Comfortable by default, hidden in Dense. add per-user setting to opt-in for teasers in Dense.

zoe-qa: also ensure keyboard shortcut `/` focuses search input even when a teaser flyout is open; tests should assert no focus lost.

rachit-ml: one last: when a run is a tool-call that failed with a schema error, the teaser should emphasize the error (red underline) and provide a 1-click 'Open diag' action.

maya-ux: great. i'll push updated Figma frames with the teaser and badge states and a short a11y checklist. can folks review by EOD Friday?

eli-devex: i can do a quick pass.

sam-frontend: i'll prototype a small component in Storybook and link it here.

zoe-qa: i'll queue the QA tickets once the storybook link lands.

maya-ux: thanks all  leaving thread open for tiny copy nits. :thumbsup:
